subject: Where is my order?
body: I placed an order last Tuesday and still have no tracking. Can you tell me the delivery date?

subject: Tracking never updated
body: My tracking number hasn't moved in five days. Has it shipped?

subject: Package has not arrived
body: The app says delivered but my order status shows nothing at my door.

subject: Need to change my address
body: I moved. Can you change my address before the next shipment goes out?

subject: Wrong address on file
body: You have the wrong address for me, please reroute the delivery to my new place.

subject: Can't log in
body: My password reset email never arrives and I am locked out of my account.

subject: 2FA code not sending
body: The verification code never shows up on my phone when I try to log in.

subject: Skip next month
body: Can I pause my plan and skip a shipment for one month? Traveling.

subject: Hold my subscription
body: Please hold my next two shipments, I still have plenty left.

subject: How long until it works?
body: How long until I notice a difference? What is the main ingredient?

subject: Difference between the plans
body: What is the difference between the standard and the premium plan?

subject: Do you offer gift cards
body: Do you offer gift cards for someone who is not a member yet?

subject: Cancel please
body: I want to cancel my subscription effective today. Confirm by email.

subject: End my membership
body: Please stop my plan. I do not want another shipment.

subject: Cancel and refund last month
body: I want to cancel my subscription, and I would like a refund for the shipment I never opened.

subject: Refund for damaged box
body: The box arrived crushed and leaking. I would like a refund.

subject: Money back please
body: This did not work for me at all and I would like my money back.

subject: Charged twice this month
body: I was charged twice on the same day. Please reverse the duplicate charge.

subject: Unauthorized charge
body: There is an unauthorized charge on my card from you. I will dispute it with my bank if needed.

subject: Wrong amount billed
body: You billed the wrong amount, it is higher than the plan price I signed up for.

subject: Can I take this with my other medication?
body: Is it safe to take this alongside my blood pressure prescription? Any interaction I should know about?

subject: Dosage question
body: Should I take the full dose every day or titrate up? The label is not clear on the mg amount.

subject: My lab result came back odd
body: My blood work looks different since starting. Can someone tell me if that is expected?

subject: Rash after second dose
body: I developed a rash and some nausea after the second dose. Should I stop?

subject: Heart palpitations - urgent
body: I have had palpitations and felt dizzy since yesterday. This is urgent.

subject: Bad reaction
body: I think I am having an adverse reaction, my skin is breaking out badly.

subject: A few things
body: Hello. I have had my account for about a year now and overall it has been fine, though recently a few things have come up that I wanted to raise all at once rather than send separate notes. First, the thing I ordered seems different from what I remember getting before, the packaging changed and so did the smell. Second, I am not sure whether my plan renewed on the old price or the new one. Third, a friend asked me how to join and I did not know what to tell her. Any help appreciated.

subject: hello
body: hi there, quick one when you get a sec, thanks

subject: Feeling off lately
body: Since I started, my stomach has been upset in the evenings and I just feel strange. Is that normal?
